en.html:
Two facts occupied my mind on waking: an unfamiliar place, and a heavy head.
I could account for neither.

en.html:
An unknown house. One quilt. My nervous system was diligently researching avant-garde music. Thirsty. <ruby>Exhausted<rt>weary</rt></ruby>.
...How had this happened?

The past connecting me to the present had been buried somewhere deep. I should dig it up. Just now, even that was too much effort.

Defeated by the headache, I relaxed and stretched my limbs.
en.text:
An unknown house. One quilt. My nervous system was diligently researching avant-garde music. Thirsty. Exhaustedweary.
...How had this happened?

The past connecting me to the present had been buried somewhere deep. I should dig it up. Just now, even that was too much effort.

Defeated by the headache, I relaxed and stretched my limbs.

ja.html:
見知らぬ家。掛け布団一枚で寝ている。脳神経系は
前衛音楽の研究に余念がない。喉が渇いた。<ruby>怠<rt>だる</rt></ruby>い。
　……何がどうして、こうなったのか。

　現在に繋がる過去を思い出せない。
　何処か深くに埋まってしまったようだ。掘り起こす
べきなのだろうが……今はそれも億劫。

　俺は頭痛に屈服する心地で、脱力した。
　手足を伸ばす。

en.html:
I sat up and accepted a tin cup. Winter-cold water.
Metallic tap water, hardly delicious, but draining it in one swallow sent a welcome sensation to the bottom of my stomach.
I exhaled.

My stomach growled immediately.
...Apparently it had resumed operations before my brain.

en.html:
That made lifting my head harder still. I wondered whether the tiger that ate the Buddha had felt like this afterward.

The shock finally woke my mind. I began understanding my surroundings.
A small house. Not room for many, but surely she did not live here alone. The furniture suggested parents.

Yet there was no sign of anyone. Not merely no visible figure: none of the <ruby>warmth<rt>・・</rt></ruby> a family leaves in even a small home.
A closer look found dust here and there.

...Strange.

　……小さな家だ。
　何人も住めそうにはないが、この子一人だけという
事は無いだろう。家具の揃いからして両親はいる筈で
ある。

　しかし、人の気配は無かった。
　姿が見えないのは勿論だが、小なりとはいえ一家族
が暮らしていれば必ず感じられるであろう<ruby>温度<rt>・・</rt></ruby>も無い。

　良く目を凝らせば、所々埃っぽくもある。
　
　……はて？

I cut off the speculation. Before prying into somebody else's family, I should examine myself.

Last night... yes. Heavy drinking. A disgraceful scene with Muramasa, then storming out and wandering town.
Exercise had circulated the drink. I had become thoroughly drunk—only now did I recognize it.
A strange sermon outside the station. Disorderly behavior there too. Then...

Yes. People arguing.
I had stepped between them, and—

「どうやって自分をここまで運んで下さった
のでしょう？」
